description_en: Removes one or more users from a user group
description_zh: 批量移除用户组内用户
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost remove-users-from-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id '１' --user-ids 1_,_2_,_3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveUsersFromGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host for which you want to remove users from the user group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
要移除用户的用户组所在堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to remove users from the user group.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要移除用户的用户组所在堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group from which you want to remove users.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query the ID of the user group
parameters.help_zh:
要移除用户的用户组的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user who you want to remove. The value is a JSON string. You can add up to 100 user IDs. If you specify multiple IDs, separate the IDs with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the IDs of users
parameters.help_zh:
要移除的用户的ID。以该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多支持设置100个用户ID，多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取用户ID
